analysis.summary: Halder Venture Limited is an integrated agri-staples company focused on rice and edible oils, operating across manufacturing, refining, storage, packaging, and distribution. During FY 2025-26, the company faced policy-led headwinds including rice export restrictions and higher edible oil import duties, which impacted standalone revenues and profitability, while consolidated performance demonstrated growth. Management advanced long-term capabilities by activating key infrastructure at the Haldia facility, expanding branded distribution, and initiating a partnership with agri-technology enterprise InQube. Over the next five years, the company aspires to grow revenue fivefold while doubling rice and edible oil capacities. Halder Venture Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for FY2025, driven by capacity enhancements, modernised facilities, and increased demand for branded staples and edible oils.

margins_costs.claim: In-house manufacturing of tins and bottles led to a combined packaging cost reduction of over 20% and 25% respectively.
margins_costs.quote: Furthermore, in-house manufacturing of both tins and bottles has led to a combined packaging cost reduction of over 20% and 25%, respectively.
